review: Remote collaboration needs delegation scope, artifact provenance, and a testable policy for result uncertainty across organizational boundaries. A2A wire examples must declare a profile. The executable protocol_interop.py exercise uses SDK 1.2.3, protocol 1.0 and JSON-RPC/SSE; 0.3 compatibility is disabled.
build: Connect two synthetic agents through a version-pinned task contract. Simulate discovery, delegated scope, delayed completion, response loss, and an untrusted returned artifact.
verify: The remote agent receives only needed data, cannot exceed delegated scope, and cancellation or timeout never claims a remote effect was undone without confirmation.
